item.description:
Release v4.0.17

Changes since v4.0.16

  • feat: Add CollaboratorProvider mirroring GitUserPreset architecture
  • feat: add conflict resolution presentation provider
  • feat: Add PluginCoAuthorSettings for co-author settings UI
  • feat: Add ProviderCoAuthor package for co-author management
  • feat: expose conflict resolver presentation bridge
  • feat(CommitForm): restructure layout and add user selector
  • feat(conflict-resolver): improve conflict resolution workflow
  • feat(git-cli): load commits across all refs
  • feat(git-libgit2): support all-ref commit loading
  • feat(kit-git): support all-ref commit history
  • feat(kit-open-in): open files in external apps
  • feat(PluginCoAuthorSettings): add edit and apply co-author management in settings
  • feat(provider-git): expose all-ref commit loading
  • fix: open conflict resolver from workspace sync
  • fix(activity-heatmap): avoid branch and worktree refresh churn
  • refactor: Update PluginCommitForm to integrate CoAuthorProviding
  • refactor: Update PluginGitConflictResolver with UI improvements
  • refactor: Update ProviderCommitForm to use CoAuthor from ProviderCoAuthor
